resolution: Hume’s first similarity/succession definition, second customary-transition definition and his counterfactual wording in VII.29 are distinct readings, not proved equivalents. Binary co-occurrence omits succession. Intervention efficacy adds independently supplied response tables; observational countermodels do not refute full-mosaic supervenience. Best-system lawhood adds selection criteria and does not by itself supply Woodward’s causal criterion. Temporal causation within spacetime is distinct from explanatory grounding of spacetime; absence of an earlier event does not entail absence of a ground. Prediction from a granted global law differs from justification for extending a finite sample.
